name: bookmark-triage
purpose: Turn a pile of saved social posts into a short list worth acting on, and drop the rest.
corpus: One saved post: author, text, links and date.

state_schema.author: handle and display name
state_schema.text: the full post text, expanded, not the preview
state_schema.engagement: likes, reposts and views when available

durable_technique.instructions: Does this post carry a technique you could still apply in six months, rather than an announcement?

criteria.true: there is a reusable method, pattern or rule in it
criteria.false: it is news, a product launch, or a claim with no method

expires.instructions: Does the value of this post depend on a version, price or lineup that will change?

depth.instructions: How much is actually in the post?
criteria: a claim with nothing behind it
a summary you could act on
a complete method with its trade-offs

verifiable.instructions: Does it point at something checkable: a repository, a paper, a doc page, or reproducible numbers?

criteria.skill_intake: a technique worth folding into the agent skill store
criteria.vault_note: worth keeping as a note, but not a skill
criteria.read_later: promising but the post itself is only a pointer

notes: Expand the post before you send it: a truncated preview ending in 'Show more' makes every answer a judgment about the preview. One request per post, so state the count before running a year of bookmarks.
